name: feat-1188-step2
title: #1188 steps 2–3 — free vectors combine, drawn head to tail (3-D)

cases.title: «w = u + v» over two declared vectors draws the head-to-tail triangle
cases.lookFor: Three coloured floating arrows u, v, w (three hues). A faded dashed copy of v starts at u's head, and w runs from u's tail to the copy's head — a closed triangle. The separate v still floats in the tray. On «הציגו תצורה אחרת» the triangle changes shape and stays closed.
cases.before: The third line was refused: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לחשב ביטוי שבו מופיע הווקטור החופשי u, ולכן «w = u + v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»

cases.title: Subtraction and a multiple follow the same rule: «w = 2u - v»
cases.lookFor: Two faded dashed copies chained head to tail from w's tail: one along u, twice as long (2u), then one pointing opposite to v (−v); w closes the triangle from the start of the 2u copy to the end of the −v copy.
cases.before: The third line was refused («… «w = 2u - v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: With stated components the sum is a value: the panel and the ask read it
cases.lookFor: The triangle drawn. Data panel: stated rows «u = (1, 2, 3)», «v = (1, 1, 1)», «w = u + v»; the vectors section shows w = (2, 3, 4) with |w|. Asking «u + v» answers (2, 3, 4); asking «2u - 3v» answers (-1, 1, 3).
cases.before: «w = u + v» was refused; asking «u + v» was not understood.

cases.title: An equation among existing vectors solves a letter: k = 2
cases.lookFor: All four lines accepted. The panel's parameters row reads «k = 2», and asking «k» answers 2.
cases.before: The fourth line was refused («… «w = u + v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: A component written with a letter, then the letter valued
cases.lookFor: After the first line: one floating arrow u, the panel reads «u = (k-1, 2, k)» and «k = ?». After «k = 3»: the panel reads «u = (2, 2, 3)» and «k = 3».
cases.before: The first line was refused («הכלי עדיין לא יודע לחשב ביטוי שבו מופיע הווקטור החופשי u, ולכן «u = (k-1, 2, k)» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: Givens that cannot all hold are refused, naming the lines
cases.lookFor: The fourth line is refused with the full sentence: «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים את «w = u + v» יחד עם «u = (1,1,1)», «v = (1,1,1)», «w = (3,2,3)»». The first three stay.
cases.before: Refused with the interim «… זו מגבלה של הכלי.» message.

cases.title: A free vector from a cube's named vector: «p = 2u» is twice the edge
cases.lookFor: The cube with the teal arrow u = AB. p (its own hue) floats in the tray, twice as long as AB and parallel to it. Panel: «p = 2u».
cases.before: The fourth line was refused («… «p = 2u» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: A stated free vector equated to an edge pins the edge
cases.lookFor: The cube is turned and sized so that AB = (1, 2, 3); asking «AB» answers (1, 2, 3).
cases.before: «AB = p» was refused («… זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: REFUSAL — a statement the tool cannot yet solve together with the figure
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused with the tool's-limit sentence quoting «AE = t·p» («… זו מגבלה של הכלי.»). The first two lines stay.

cases.title: Regression: the cube's anchored sum still builds
lines: נסמן: AB = u, AD = v, AA' = w
cases.lookFor: All three lines accepted, as before; no floating arrow appears.
